resources.string: Your mining fleet, in your pocket.
Talks only to the miners on your network — or over your Tailscale VPN. No account, no cloud.
Real hashrate, temps, power and health — clearly marked when a value is estimated or unavailable.
Reboot, pool, fan and firmware-bounded tuning with confirmations and rollback, only where verified.
Your data stays on this device. Hi3 Pool and MMP views are optional, read-only, and off by default.
Next you can scan your network, add a miner by IP, or try demo mode.
